schema.title: Influence Line Beam Force Data Request
schema.description: Request body for one beam force or moment influence-line data result.

Argument.description: Beam force or moment influence data query arguments.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Optional output file path. Supported extensions are .TXT and .JSON. When omitted, no file is saved. .TXT saves the original MIDAS text layout; .JSON saves the structured JSON result.

UNIT.description: Unit system used for the returned influence data.

FORCE.description: Force unit, such as kN or N.

DIST.description: Distance unit, such as m or mm.

LANE_NAME.description: Selected line or surface lane name.

KEY_ELEM.description: Beam element number at which the force or moment influence is evaluated.

COMPONENTS.description: Beam position and force, moment, bimoment, torsion, or warping component.

COMP.description: One beam force or moment component.
